fork_status_and_schedule.highlight: EIP-8141 SFI'd at last ACDE; native AA is absolute priority for Hegota fork
Call moving to weekly cadence, then dialing back to bi-weekly as needed

client_updates.highlight: Spec considered stable enough to target Frame DevNet 0 within ~1 week; Nethermind and ethrex ready now, Geth ready next week, Besu not ready (no ETA)

ethrex launched permissioned public Frame Transactions testnet (faucet.frames.ethrex.xyz) and closed ethrex-only Hegota devnet (faucet.hegota.ethrex.xyz) with EIP-8250, EIP-8272, EIP-7805, EIP-7906, native UTXOs PoC, EIP-8369

eip_proposals_hegota.highlight: EIP-8272 (Recent Roots): lightclient proposes moving out of transaction envelope into a canonical frame/mempool rule, avoiding protocol change; gas cost and reorg safety discussed; no decision, offline follow-up requested

Signature list removal proposed: replace outer signature list with a SIGNATURE frame mode pointing to a precompile; downside is 20 bytes per tx vs. 1 byte for scheme ID; community asked to weigh in async

Max verified gas limit of 100K flagged as too low for ZK privacy use cases; Nethermind measured 236K needed for a single private pool withdrawal; 350K estimated for 4 nullifiers; limit is mempool-only and can be raised without an EIP

eip_proposals_discussion.highlight: Chris (Base/8130) presented unified transaction type exploration: contract/precompile-first, frame-mode verify, selector handling to align 8130 keystore auth with 8141 code-as-authority; no concrete proposal, directional brainstorm

EIP-8288 (STARK frame / LeanVM aggregation) discussed for PQ private txs; lightclient cautions against gating signature aggregation on ZK-EVM readiness; XMSS aggregation via LeanVM considered the near-term path

action_items.action: Think offline on whether EIP-8272 Recent Roots should stay in the transaction envelope or move to a canonical frame/mempool rule; post findings to EIP-8141 R&D Discord channel
Review spec PRs linked in the PM issue (agenda); Nethermind running benchmarks to determine safe max verified gas limit above 100K

decisions.decision: Frame DevNet 0 to launch within approximately one week, without waiting for Besu
100K max verified gas cap is a conservative starting point only; will be raised experimentally once devnets are running — no EIP required to adjust

targets.target: Frame DevNet 0 — targeting launch within ~1 week of September 1, 2026
